# the browser model setting opens the model picker on language models, a meta key check that never answers says checking while the screen stays live, esc cancels it, and the pick writes the setting
type /settings
key enter
key right
key right
key right
key right
key right
key right
key right
wait Browser model
key down
key down
key down
key enter
wait ASSIGN TO
type muse-spark-1.3
wait Meta · no key
absent jev-latest
screen
key enter
wait Meta key
type meta-made-up-silent-0a9f
key enter
wait checking with Meta
wait esc cancel
absent 0a9f
screen
key esc
absent checking with Meta
wait ASSIGN TO
key enter
paste meta-made-up-accepted-3d7e
key enter
wait Browser model now runs meta/muse-spark-1.3
wait meta/muse-spark-1.3  ▾
absent 3d7e
screen
